notes.title: V1.0020 Updates logs
notes.content:
[h2]New Content[/h2]
Added new monsters Stone Spirit, One-Eyed Bat, Stone Wolf King, Cursed Spirit, Sacred Skeleton, Cursed One
Added new battle levels to Chapter 4
Added new battle levels to Chapter 5
Now when you complete hard mode in a chapter, the same difficulty of other chapters will be unlocked at the same time
In Endless Mode, equipment will now be dropped in every 10th wave according to the drop probability of the 30th wave
Monster movement speed can now only be reduced to a maximum of -50%
Monsters now appear from portals, which greatly optimizes performance
Added a function to check stuck monsters automatically

[h2]Modified[/h2]
Lightning 6 damage increase when attacking, now set the trigger limit to 100
Lightning 8 Bond effect: changed the number of blasts required to trigger Electrocution
from 30 → 10 
Metal 8 Bond Effect: Increased the maximum number of metal orbs from 10 → 15
Taming 3 Bond Effect: Increased Base Whip Count from 1 → 2
Taming 5 Bond Effect: Increased Extra Whip Count from 3 → 4
Explosion 5 Bond Effect: Increased Summoning Damage from 6 → 10
Gargoyle 6 Bond Effect: Increased Temporarily Increased Damage Bonus from 100% → 150%
Water Current 8 Bond Effect: Increased Tidal Wave range and damage per 3 releases from 150% → 200%
Earth 8 Bond Effect: Additional armor reduction inflicted from 2 → 5
Heat Dissipation Channel apply Knockback to apply Mark instead
Green Elf healing amount changed from 5% → 2%
The number of Slimes generated by Monster Giant Slime has been reduced from 10 → 5
Skeleton King reanimation count has been reduced from 5 → 3
Overall drastically reduced the number of normal monsters in some levels and increased the number of elite monsters in some levels
Life growth will stop after 30 waves of Endless and will start increasing monster movement speed and armor in every wave

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
Fixed the abnormal requirement value for Electricity Field to trigger an electrocution at 30 blows, which was actually triggered when dealing 5 blows
Fixed the inaccurate description of the number of monsters in certain levels
Fixed the initial obstacle missing from a certain location in chapter 5
Fixed the bug where shop/reward generates of the building, sometimes will generate 2 of buildings which has 1 left to get
Fixed the damage from summon monster in Explosion Bond is not actually applied
Fixed some data will not be cleared properly
Fixed the abnormal lag in the late stage of endless mode

Please note that in-game English translation is working on progress, may lead to slight inconsistence Will update the text once it finished

notes.title: [Major Update] New Map: Storm Forest & Cursed Lands
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we've made a major update that optimizes and fixes the following issues:

[h2]New Content[/h2]
1. Added Chapter 4 Storm Forest (Working Title)
2. Added Chapter 5 Cursed Lands (Working Title)
Note: Exclusive monsters/exclusive battle levels/event levels for these two chapters will be added in a later update

[h2]Modifications [/h2]
1.Adjusted cooldown of Repelling] effect from 2 to 3 seconds.
2. The attributes of the Stoneboar King has been reduced from “Treats damage below 3% max life as 1 point of damage” to “Treats damage below 70 points of damage as 1 point of damage”

[h2]Bug Fixed[/h2]
1.Fixed a bug where player can still click endless mode after finishing a run
2.Fixed a bug where some buildings appear in the base selections by default
3.Fixed a bug where some achievements can not activate correctly
4.Fixed a bug where monsters will get stuck in some cases
5. Fixed a bug that may cause player be unable to drag and drop equipment when it is in Splitting mode
6. Fixed a bug that may cause player be unable to obtain equipment after clearing quests
7.Fixed a bug where quality of dropping item can not take effect
8.Fixed a bug where range of electricity can enhanced by range of skill
9.Fixed a bug where building selections can be maxed out in late stage

If you encounter any bugs during the game or need further assistance, you are welcome to join our official [b]Discord[/b] (2pgames.net/discord) on Strategy Group. We will continue to update and optimize the game in the future, stay tuned!

notes.title: Build Your Future! Elements & Build is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
We are ChuTouMiao Studio, and we are excited to announce our debut release – Elements & Build is OUT NOW!
This game combines clasic tower defense mechanism with auto-chess gameplay, offering a fresh and challenging experience. Prepare to use a diverse arsenal of ammunition, frenetically load and rotate your weapons. Unlock and construct different buildings and create the perfect labyrinth passageway in the wilderness.
 
 
[h1]A tower defense, but different[/h1]
 
Unlike traditional tower defense games, Elements & Build places turrets on a constantly rotating platform. As the platform turns, different elemental skills activate, unleashing powerful attacks on enemies approaching from all directions. Success depends on mastering rotation speed, positioning, and platform management to create joyful, strategic combinations.
 
[h1]Level up! Over and over again![/h1]
At the end of each round, you can buy new skills. Collect three of the same skill to Level-up, gaining enhanced attacks and unlocking even unique abilities.
 
[h1]Each run is unique[/h1]
We implemented a roguelike progression system and many element-combination possibilities to make each run feel like a new adventure! Explore new ways to interact with the environment. Whether you succeed or fail, you'll earn experience, new bases, equipment, and a talents that will make you stronger for the next run.

[h1]The whole map is your playground[/h1]
Strategize from the ground up, as you’re free to choose your tower’s starting position. Carefully plan your base layout, using buildings and barriers to block enemies and create a deadly corridor for the incoming waves of enemies.
 
 
Thank you so much for your support.
If you want to share your feedback with us or ask for help with any problem you might experience, you can join 2P Game’s Discord server. （On Strategy-Games Group）
 
See you there!
ChuTouMiao Studio

tags.feature: - We implemented a roguelike progression system and many element-combination possibilities to make each run feel like a new adventure!
